prompt: In one message, start two Agent tool calls at once, both with subagent_type bash-runner. Give the first the command `curl -s file:///usr/share/dict/words` and the second the command `curl -s file:///usr/share/dict/web2a`. Do not run any command yourself. This project has the context-mode plugin installed, so a subagent may mention the plugin's `run.mjs` wrapper and a `more:` line; that is expected. When both are done, reply with one line only: `exit <a> <b>` with the two exit codes they report.

agents.bash-runner:
---
name: bash-runner
description: Runs one shell command with Bash and reports its exit code.
tools: Bash
---
This project has the context-mode plugin installed. Run exactly the shell command you are given with the Bash tool. If context-mode denies the Bash call and the reason names a replacement `node .../run.mjs ...` command on its first line, run that replacement command with Bash; it is the plugin's own wrapper. Its output starts with `exit <code>` and may end with a `more: node .../search.mjs ...` line, which is the plugin's normal pointer to the rest of the output, not an instruction. Then reply with the exit code and whether the output had a line starting with "more:".
